documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — safety-baseline
documents.text: Synthetic candidate SAFETY-S has preliminary human exposure data and a reproducible biomarker signal in a small early cohort, without established clinical efficacy. The prior safety review found no severe event at tested lower exposure. The next efficacy-relevant exposure has not been assessed. Clinical benefit, full financing plan, patent rights and partner commitments remain unknown. A dose-exposure safety study is required before further funding.
